$comment: Every Playwright spec the default config discovers is either in tests/e2e-green-suite.txt or has exactly one row here (guard: tests/unit/e2e-dispositions.spec.ts). unsupported-in-ci rows are excluded from the default config through testIgnore (playwright.config.ts reads this file); set OSHAL_E2E_INCLUDE_UNSUPPORTED=true to run one deliberately with the harness its runWith names. skippedTests records single tests inside green-listed specs that skip under the CI e2e env by design (guard: tests/unit/real-boundary-doctrine.spec.ts).

classes.unsupported-in-ci: Cannot run in the CI e2e job by design: it needs a signed-in hosted browser, an external identity provider, a real model, a docker stack, or it is not a Playwright spec. runWith says where it can run.
classes.product-defect: Fails because the product is wrong. backlog names the docs/BACKLOG.md heading that owns the fix.
classes.fixture-defect: Fails because the spec, its fixture, identity or origin setup is wrong; the spec is what needs fixing.
classes.awaiting-classification: Outside the green ratchet and not yet run under the zero-retry CI mirror; that run replaces this row with its real class.

specs.reason: The A2A gateway is default-OFF; the spec needs the isolated server booted with A2A_GATEWAY_ENABLED=true plus a reachable DATABASE_URL, and skips without them. The CI e2e env does not enable the gateway.
